source: JEOL press release: Launch of the ACE eye TEM for Semiconductor Analysis (08-14-2026)

players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: JEOL developed the ACE eye transmission electron microscope (TEM) for semiconductor analysis and began sales in July 2026. It automates the whole measurement workflow from TEM/STEM observation to EDS analysis (recipes, semi- to fully automatic operation, AI-based automatic aberration correction) for R&D, process evaluation and failure analysis of devices such as gate-all-around (GAA) transistors and 3D NAND. Specifications: at 200 kV, TEM lattice image <=0.10 nm and dark- / bright-field STEM <=0.10 nm; cold field-emission electron gun; 60 to 200 kV; an ASCOR spherical aberration corrector manufactured by CEOS as standard; EDS solid angle 2.2 sr; magnification reproducibility of +/-0.5%; the optional MultiSPECPORTER autoloader stores up to 12 specimen grids for unattended continuous measurement.
quarterly_data.figure: sales from July 2026; STEM resolution <=0.10 nm at 200 kV; 60 to 200 kV; EDS 2.2 sr; up to 12 specimen grids
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (ASCOR spherical aberration corrector, standard on ACE eye)
